authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4721 calati gives the cal-/cāl- walk verb. The selected calā/cāllo forms are ordinary verbal inflections; initial h or zero needs local correspondence evidence. Reviewed comparison: had cāl “walk!” (f_zza5at5rmrshi). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
